item.title: Spring forward Sunday
item.description: Less sleep this go around with Day Light Saving Time beginning around 2 A.M. Sunday morning. Sunshine returns for the late morning hours.

item.title: Tyler 'Snoop' Huntley returns to Ravens on two-year deal
item.description: Tyler Huntley is returning to the Ravens. According to ESPN's Adam Schefter, Huntley is signing a two-year deal worth up to $11 million.
